 Print Tilak Varma (BCCI Photo) NEW DELHI: Tilak Varma created history on Saturday by becoming the fielder with the most catches in T20 Internationals in a calendar year. The Indian cricketer took two catches in the opening three overs of New Zealand's innings in the second T20I, dismissing Tim Seifert and Daryl Mitchell. With these catches, Tilak moved past Indonesia's Danilson Hawoe, who held the previous record with 25 catches in 2025. Watch Tilak Varma on batting at No. 5 and 6: ‘I want to finish games for the country’ Tilak has now taken 26 catches as a fielder in T20Is in 2026, setting a new world record.  India make two changes for 2nd T20I
 India won the toss and elected to bowl against New Zealand in the second T20 International on Saturday. India made two changes to their playing XI. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi replaced the injured Ishan Kishan, while Prince Yadav came in for Mayank Yadav. New Zealand also made one change, bringing in Jacob Duffy in place of Adam Milne. India vs New Zealand 2nd T20I: Playing XIs
 India: Abhishek Sharma, Sanju Samson (wk), Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Shreyas Iyer (c), Tilak Varma, Naman Dhir, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Axar Patel, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Arshdeep Singh, Prince Yadav. New Zealand: Finn Allen, Tim Seifert (wk), Daryl Mitchell, Glenn Phillips, Bevon Jacobs, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner (c), Nathan Smith, Matt Henry, Jacob Duffy, Lockie Ferguson.
